jordan.patel: Hey people-ops — quick help needed. New hire Liya K has a family emergency and needs to fly out tonight. She has an approved H-1B (I-797) but the consular stamping appointment is next week. If she ends up being out of the country > a few weeks, what are our options for re-entry, onboarding, and any documentation she must carry? Can she still start remotely? cc @anya.ramos  

anya.ramos: Sorry to hear that, Jordan — we can support. High-level: we can 1) enable a short remote start, 2) request an expedited consulate appointment via counsel, and 3) prepare an employer emergency travel letter for Liya to carry. Need to confirm a few facts first (see checklist below). Please have Liya upload scans ASAP. :pray: 

anya.ramos: Emergency checklist (what we need from Liya right now):
- passport bio page scan
- I-797 approval notice (PDF)
- offer letter + start date
- DS-160 confirmation page
- travel itinerary (flight e-ticket)
- any hospital/medical note if relevant for expedite
We’ll also ask counsel to draft the employer letter. Link to form to collect these: https://intranet.redwood/immigration/emergency-travel  

hr-bot: Form submitted: /forms/immigration-expedite (auto-confirmation). If you haven't submitted, please complete the form so we can start counsel request.

sreena.iyer: From legal: counsel can request an expedited appointment and provide a consulate-facing letter. Important points:
- If Liya's current visa stamp is valid, she can re-enter with existing stamp + I-797. If the stamp is expired or she never had one, re-entry requires stamping.
- For H-1B, there is no domestic "advance parole" alternative for initial entry — stamping at a consulate is the usual route.
- Counsel will also prepare a short employer attestation stating criticality of role and family emergency context for expedite.
- Please note consulates decide case-by-case; no guarantee, but expedite improves odds.

sreena.iyer: Quick template we can use to send to counsel/consulate: 
```
Subject: Request for Emergency Visa Appointment — Liya K (Passport: X1234567)

Dear Consular Officer,

Liya K is a newly hired software engineer at Redwood Inference with an H-1B approval (I-797). Due to a family emergency requiring immediate travel, we request an expedited visa stamping appointment. Attached: offer letter, I-797, DS-160 confirmation, passport, and employer attestation. Liya is scheduled to begin employment on 2026-04-01 but will be able to start remotely if assistance is granted.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference — People Ops / Legal
```

mike.chen: Eng chiming in — we can onboard Liya remotely for up to 2 weeks without impacting ramp. Please confirm whether we should ship laptop now or hold until she returns. Also we need the final start date for access requests.

kelly.nguyen: Payroll/benefits notes: if her start date is pushed beyond 30 days we may need to re-trigger benefits enrollment windows and re-issue documents. Please have Liya complete her new-hire paperwork and I-9 materials now. For I-9: remote verification is possible via an authorized representative abroad or by inspection at a U.S. consulate in some cases — we’ll coordinate with our I-9 vendor and legal.

jordan.patel: Liya is uploading docs to the form now. Manager asked to tentatively move start to 2026-04-05 in case stamping takes longer. @anya can you loop counsel and confirm whether we should ship the laptop? Manager prefers to ship but hold activation until she confirms return.

anya.ramos: Looping counsel now (cc: @sreena.iyer). We'll ask them to file an expedite and draft the employer letter. On equipment: we can ship with encrypted disk and require sign-off before VPN access. I'll confirm shipping policy and logistics. Also — we will cover expedite fee and any reasonable travel-related certified document costs.

jordan.patel: Thanks — I'll update the hiring team and Liya. Will share the uploaded docs when complete. If counsel needs anything else, ping me or Liya directly. :thumbsup:

anya.ramos: Final note for Liya we will send: short travel packet with (1) employer letter, (2) checklist, (3) sample consulate email (above), (4) HR contact + counsel contact. We aim to have the packet within 4 business hours once docs are uploaded. Keep us posted and safe travel. :heart:
